children: Thomas V. Reifenheiser, a Director, sold 8,099 shares of Class A common stock on September 14, 2026 at a weighted-average price of $149.0308 per share. The total sale amount reported was $1,207,000. After the transaction, Reifenheiser directly owned 36,387 Class A shares. The filing notes the reported price is a weighted-average and that the shares were sold in multiple transactions at prices ranging from $148.75 to $149.23.
